text:
maya: Quick heads-up — grafana shows heavy ingestion lag for Prom -> Cortex in us-west, started ~10:12 UTC. Remote connections are being reset and write failures spiking. Anyone else seeing this?

alex: Looking now. Are we seeing exporter churn or network flaps? Can you paste the remote_write error lines?

maya: Paste logs:
```
level=error ts=2025-12-05T10:12:34Z caller=queue_manager.go msg="remote_write failed" err="write tcp 10.4.5.6:58612->10.x.y.z:9201: connection reset by peer"
```

sam: We had a rolling node drain in cluster-ml-west-1 around that time, kube-controller did some evictions. Exporters may be re-registering with slightly different labels causing per-series bump and queue_hot spikes.

jordan: If it's exporter churn + slight label variance -> spikes in series cardinality and queue size. Short term: mute the "prometheus_remote_write_errors" alert and scale up the queue limits on the remote_write config.

maya: Hacked together a relabel to drop podTemplateHash and pod_revision labels from prometheus scrape to reduce series churn. Putting snippet in PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/789

sam: relabel snippet we used:
```
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_pod_template_hash]
  action: drop
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_pod_revision]
  action: drop
```

alex: Also increase queue_config in our prometheus:
```
remote_write:
  - url: https://cortex-us-west.redwood/api/prom/push
    queue_config:
      max_samples_per_send: 500
      max_shards: 200
      capacity: 25000
```
That should buy time until exporters stabilize.

alertmanager-bot: Alert muted: prometheus_remote_write_errors for 2h by @jordan :mute:

deploy-bot: Applied prom config patch to canary replicas (2/4) — monitoring

maya: Thanks — monitoring dashboards look steadyish. Will follow up after PR merges. :thumbsup:
